violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: RAW CLASSIC WINGS AT 60F, RAW CLASSIC TENDERS AT 46F IN BREADING STATION; RAW CLASSIC TENDERS AT 46F, RAW CLASSIC CHICKEN AT 46-60F IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO TRANSFER FOODS TO FREEZER FOR RAPID COOLING TO 41F DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: IN DELFIELD 1 DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE THERMOMETER AND ENSURE ALL UNITS ARE PROVIDED WITH THERMOMETERS

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: DELFIELD 1 DOOR PREP TOP AT 48F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE REPAIR AND ENSURE TCS FOODS ARE NOT STORED IN UNIT UNTIL REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOOD TEMPERATURES OF 41F OR BELOW.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours: RICE AT 87-92F FOR 5 HOURS IN COVERED CONTAINER ON BACK KITCHEN COUNTER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD RICE DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE MONITOR COOLING OF RICE WITH THERMOMETER TO ENSURE COOLING PARAMETERS ARE MET: 135F TO 70F IN 2 HOURS AND TO A FURTHER 41F WITHIN A TOTAL OF 6 HOURS.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: RICE AT 87-92F FOR 5 HOURS IN COVERED CONTAINER ON BACK KITCHEN COUNTER.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED RICE DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE RICE IS UNCOVERED DURING COOLING; USE THERMOMETER TO MONITOR TEMPERATURES; STIR REGULARLY AND USE REFRIGERATOR OR FREEZER TO RAPIDLY COOL FOODS IF NECESSARY TO ENSURE COOLING PARAMETERS ARE MET.

violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: OBSERVED RICE AT 121F FOR 1.75 HOURS IN COVERED CONTAINER IN ICE BATH ON BACK KITCHEN COUNTER TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REHEAT RICE TO 165F AND RESUME COOLING IN ICE BATH. PLEASE ENSURE HOT FOODS ARE COOLED IN UNCOVERED CONTAINERS ALONG WITH OTHER APPROPRIATE METHODS. MONITOR FOOD TEMPERATURES TO ENSURE THAT FOODS MEET THE COOLING PARAMETERS OF 135F TO 70F WITHIN 2 HOURS AND TO A FURTHER 41F WITHIN A TOTAL OF 6 HOURS.
